answer: Audits are published in pigment, queued in comet, and trellis publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 57 identities per epoch. A farm of 166 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4203 identities would post 1311 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
